ContextQualifiedId.description:
A canonical `<context>_<opaque>` reference.

Context names are lowercase ASCII slugs. Opaque components are deliberately
restricted to lowercase base36-compatible text so comparison is stable
across databases, filesystems, and URL encoders.

EvidenceMaterial.description: One supporting `materials` entry referenced, but not attested to, by the predicate.

digest.description: Immutable content digest of the material artifact.

name.description: Human-readable role of this material (for example `"baseline-observation"`).

EvidenceScope.description: Organization/run binding bound once into the predicate.

run_id.description: Remediation Runs run this bundle finalizes evidence for.

RecordedVerdict.description:
Local mirror of Remediation Runs' `RecordedVerdict`.

Evidence never recomputes a verdict; it only records, verbatim, the value
Verification produced and Remediation Runs already accepted. This type is
intentionally re-declared here (rather than imported across the bounded
context boundary) so Evidence's published predicate never depends on
another context's internal aggregate.

oneOf.description: Candidate satisfied the policy for the named fixture.
Available observations could not establish a result.
Verification observed a prohibited information flow.

description:
Cauterizer-owned predicate body (schema major `2`).

Identical to [`EvidencePredicateBodyV1`] with one additional
required field, `policy_ref`.

assessment_ref.description: Immutable reference to the Verification assessment this bundle attests to.

materials.description: Supporting materials referenced by, but not asserted as, the subject.

policy_ref.description:
Immutable reference to the exact verification policy version bound to
`verdict`. Absent from schema major `1`; required from `2` onward.
